performance.title: Data & Performance
performance.freshnessHelp: Controls how often weather, flights and sites data is refreshed in your browser. Economy mode reduces bandwidth usage.
performance.autoRefreshHelp: Automatically refreshes weather data and emagram analysis in the background while the page is open.
performance.httpTimeoutHelp: Maximum wait time for server requests. Increase if you have a slow connection.
performance.backendCacheHelp: How long the server keeps weather data in cache (Redis). After expiration, data is re-fetched from external sources (Open-Meteo, WeatherAPI, etc.).
performance.spotairLiveWindRadiusHelp: Distance around the site used to fetch SpotAiR stations. A larger radius finds more stations but may include less representative ones.
performance.spotairLiveWindCacheHelp: How long the server keeps SpotAiR live wind readings before re-fetching.
performance.schedulerIntervalHelp: Interval between each automatic weather forecast collection for your favorite sites (today and tomorrow). A shorter interval gives fresher forecasts but uses more external API calls.

thresholds.title: Weather thresholds
thresholds.description: These thresholds drive backend Para-Index scoring and frontend display. Values save automatically when you leave the field.

wind.title: Wind (km/h)
wind.help: Mainly affects the base Para-Index score and the low / optimal / strong wind categorization.

gust.title: Gusts (km/h)
gust.help: Strongly influences safety penalties and volatility alerts.

precipitation.title: Rain (mm)
precipitation.help: Adjusts rain bonuses / penalties and the rainfall limit for a flyable slot.

instability.title: Instability (Lifted Index)
instability.help: Controls how sensitive the score and time slots are to atmospheric instability.

temperature.title: Temperature (°C)
temperature.help: Defines the temperature bonus thresholds applied to the hourly score.

verdict.title: Para-Index verdict
verdict.help: Defines the boundaries between GOOD, MEDIUM, LIMIT, and BAD.

ui.title: UI display
ui.help: Adjusts the textual reasons shown in the flyability column (frontend only).
